title: Ankhorage Graph HydraDB
summary: Provides a native HTTP persistence adapter for the canonical Ankhorage graph persistence port.
purpose: Translate canonical graph persistence reads into HydraDB HTTP queries without leaking HydraDB transport or credentials into graph consumers.
responsibilities: Execute supported node lookup operations through HydraDB's native HTTP API.
Expose truthful capability discovery for unsupported provider behavior.
boundaries: Does not define graph persistence contracts or graph algorithms.
Does not expose HydraDB mutation behavior as atomic canonical mutations.
Does not read environment variables or persist credentials.
audience: Server-side applications selecting HydraDB for canonical graph reads.
useCases: Retrieve stored graph nodes by canonical identifiers.

architecture.role: Outbound provider adapter implementing the published @ankhorage/graph/persistence boundary.
invariants: Transport remains private behind the public factory.
Unsupported operations return the canonical unsupported result before provider writes.

security: Bearer tokens remain transient configuration and are excluded from errors.
limitations: HydraDB v0.5.0 cannot yet prove the atomic mutation and traversal guarantees required by the canonical port.
